quarterly_data.quarter: Sterlite Technologies press release: STL strengthens its Neuralis portfolio with Pre-Terminated (09-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: STL added Pre-Terminated Fiber Trunk Assemblies to its Neuralis data-center portfolio: indoor 48F-576F (cable diameter 5.8 mm to 12.2 mm) and indoor/outdoor 144F-6912F (6912 fibers at 32.0 mm), factory-terminated in MMC, MTP/MPO and LC formats and 100% factory tested, using its IBR rollable-ribbon technology.
